name: Apartmenets Goldberger
beschreibung: The stylish Apartments Goldberger in Söll provide first-rate holiday apartments designed for ultimate comfort and relaxation. Each apartment features contemporary furnishings and a fully equipped kitchen, while the private balcony opens up captivating views of the surrounding alpine wonderland. Söll is situated in the scenic Sölllandl region, renowned for its excellent tourist infrastructure. In winter, the premier ski areas of the Wilder Kaiser holiday region are within quick and easy reach, whereas summer invites guests to explore countless hiking and cycling trails. An exceptional accommodation choice for both families and couples.
